title: The test-runner meta-tests merge into one fast file
body:
Why: audit (.krn/runs/lead/breakthrough/audit.md): the four test-suite-* runner meta-tests weigh ~24 s of ~140 s CI; rule tests ~2 s, cutting them saves nothing.
Outcome: test-suite-shards, -speed, -shards-config, -failures share fixtures in one file; weights updated.
Proof: shard weights total drops by >= 15 s with no coverage lost.
Scope: test/, scripts/lib/.
